name: DSI Mopho
source: Dave Smith Instruments, Mopho Operation Manual, Version 1.2 (August 2009), pp. 13-14 (Globals), 30-44 (MIDI Implementation, NRPN, Global/Program Parameter Data, SysEx, Packed Data Format). https://sequential.com/downloads/mopho/doc/Mopho_Manual_v.1.2.pdf. NRPN<->sysexIndex mapping cross-checked against Edisyn edisyn/synth/dsiprophet08/DSIProphet08.java (mophoParams table), https://github.com/eclab/edisyn.

nrpnFormat.notes: Standard NRPN on the global MIDI channel: CC99 (0x63) param MSB, CC98 (0x62) param LSB, CC6 (0x06) value MSB, CC38 (0x26) value LSB. Param number and value are each split into 7-bit halves (MSB = n>>7, LSB = n&0x7F); MSB is 0-1 for program params (values up to 254, numbers up to 199) and 3 for globals (384-406). Mopho transmits in running-status form (one B0+ch status then the four CC pairs). On receive it tracks the most recent NRPN number, so partial messages work, but send all four. Also responds to Data Increment CC96 (0x60) / Decrement CC97 (0x61) on the selected NRPN, and to the RPN/NRPN reset (RPN number MSB+LSB = 0x7F 0x7F, i.e. presumably CC101=127 + CC100=127 -- see uncertain) to deselect the NRPN.
nrpnFormat.transmit: When Global 'MIDI Parameter Send' = NRPN, changes made on the front panel are transmitted as NRPN. When = CC, only the CC-mapped subset is transmitted (see per-param 'cc'). When Off, nothing is transmitted. The Volume knob transmits CC7; bank changes transmit CC32 (0-2) + Program Change.
nrpnFormat.receive: NRPN is applied when Global 'MIDI Parameter Receive' = All or NRPN; CC map is applied when = All or CC.

sysex.notes: Device ID 0x25 (37) = Mopho desktop (Mopho Keyboard/SE = 0x27, Mopho x4 = 0x29 -- different param layouts, not covered here). Global 'MIDI SysEx' must be On to send or receive SysEx. UNIVERSAL DEVICE INQUIRY: send F0 7E <ch> 06 01 F7 (ch = 0x7F always answered; otherwise must match channel 0-15 unless Mopho is on ALL). Reply: F0 7E <ch|7F> 06 02 01 25 01 00 00 <ver> 00 00 F7 -- 01 = DSI, 25 01 = family LS/MS (Mopho), 00 00 = family member, <ver> = 0jjjnnnn (jjj minor rev, nnnn major rev). REQUEST PROGRAM DUMP: F0 01 25 05 <bank 0-2> <program 0-127> F7 -> Program Data Dump. REQUEST EDIT BUFFER DUMP: F0 01 25 06 F7 -> Edit Buffer Data Dump. REQUEST GLOBAL DUMP: F0 01 25 0E F7 -> F0 01 25 0F <20 nibbles, LS then MS, for the 10 globals in index order 0-9> F7 (transmit-only; a received global dump is ignored -- use NRPN 384-406 to change globals). PROGRAM DATA DUMP: F0 01 25 02 <bank 0-2> <program 0-127> <293 packed bytes> F7 = 300 bytes total. Sending one to the Mopho stores it to that bank/program. EDIT BUFFER DUMP: F0 01 25 03 <293 packed bytes> F7 = 298 bytes total. PACKED MS-BIT FORMAT: the 256-byte unpacked program is split into groups of 7 bytes; each group is sent as 8 MIDI bytes: first a header byte holding the stripped bit 7 of each of the 7 data bytes (bit 0 = MSB of data byte 1, bit 1 = MSB of byte 2, ... bit 6 = MSB of byte 7), then the 7 data bytes with bit 7 cleared. 256 = 36 full groups (288 MIDI bytes) + a final partial group of 4 data bytes (1 header + 4 = 5 MIDI bytes) = 293. Unpack: for each 8-byte packet, out[k] = pkt[k+1] | (((pkt[0] >> k) & 1) << 7). Unpacked length 256 (only indices 0-199 used; 109-119 and 200-255 unused -- write 0). VALUE ENCODING in the dump: raw unsigned, same as NRPN values (bipolar params stored offset, e.g. 0-254 with 127 = 0; NOT two's complement). Unpacked byte index = each param's 'sysexIndex', which differs from its NRPN number for most params (NRPN numbering kept Prophet '08-compatible). NAME: 16 characters at unpacked indices 184-199 (also NRPN 184-199, one char per NRPN), 7-bit ASCII, range 32-127, space-padded, no terminator.

messages.editBufferDump: [240, 1, 37, 3, ...293 packed bytes..., 247] -- 298 bytes; 256 unpacked bytes indexed by sysexIndex
messages.programDump: [240, 1, 37, 2, {bank 0-2}, {program 0-127}, ...293 packed bytes..., 247] -- 300 bytes; receiving it writes to that bank/program
messages.globalDump: [240, 1, 37, 15, ...20 nibbles (LS nibble then MS nibble per global, globals 0-9)..., 247] -- transmit only

shapeEncoding: Osc 1/2 Shape (NRPN 2 / 7) is a single 0-103 value: 0 = Off, 1 = Sawtooth, 2 = Triangle, 3 = Saw/Tri mix, 4-103 = Pulse with width 0-99 (width = value - 4; square = Pulse 50 = value 54). The pulse turns off at the two extremes (widths 0 and 99). Pulse-width mod destinations (6/7/8) act on this.

requiredGlobals.notes: Set on the Mopho (hold PROGRAM MODE until 'Global Parameter' shows; PROGRAM knob selects, +/- changes) or via the NRPNs below once receive is working.

uncertain: Mod destination value 22: the manual's value table prints 'LFO 3 Amt' twice (21 and 22); the display list on p.26 shows 22 = LFO 4 Amt, which is used here.
Mod destination 13 is 'Pan Spread' in the value table and 'Output Pan / Stereo Pan Position' in the display list -- same destination, label combined.
Key Assign (NRPN 96) options are listed without numbers in the manual; assumed 0-5 in the printed order (Low, Low Retrig, High, High Retrig, Last, Last Retrig).
LFO Amount: the parameter description says 0...100, the Program Parameter Data table says 0-127. Table (0-127) used.
Sub Osc 1/2 level: description says 1...127, table says 0-127. Table used.

Seq tracks 2-4 steps are listed 0-126 (126 = Reset, no Rest); track 1 is 0-127 with 127 = Rest. The prose says 'the two highest values are Reset and Rest' for all tracks. Table ranges used -- editor should not send 127 to tracks 2-4.

Assignable Parameter 1-4 (NRPN 105-108) value = program-parameter index. Manual only says 0-183; Edisyn treats it as the sysexIndex (unpacked-dump position), with 105-119 invalid. Edisyn's list extends to 199 (name chars) but the manual caps at 183.
Push It Note (NRPN 111) 0-120 displays C0...C10; the manual does not say whether value 0 corresponds to MIDI note 0 or is an offset like Osc Freq. Treated like Osc Freq (0 = C0).
Note naming: the manual says C3 is middle C for Osc Freq display; the mapping from value to Hz/MIDI note beyond 'C0 = ~8 Hz, 10 octaves' is not specified.
CC scaling for CC-mapped params whose range exceeds 0-127 (Filter Freq 0-164, Filter/Env 3 Env Amount 0-254, BPM 30-250) is not documented. Use NRPN for these.

The manual does not explicitly state that turning Assignable knobs 1-4 transmits the NRPN of the parameter currently assigned to that knob (it says 'changes to the values of front panel controls are transmitted'). Expected but unverified on hardware.
Whether a received Program Change is echoed, and which channel is used for transmission when MIDI Channel = All, is not documented.
NRPNs 28, 95, 99, 102-104, 109-110 and 117-119 are not assigned on the Mopho (holes from the Prophet '08 layout); do not send them.

RPN reset: the manual prints the controller numbers as binary 0010 0101 / 0010 0100 (= CC37 / CC36) with value 0111111 (7 digits). Standard RPN MSB/LSB are CC101/CC100 (0110 0101 / 0110 0100) with 127 = null; the printed bits look like a typo. Unverified.

Global dump response nibble order: manual says '20 nibbles (LS then MS) for 10 Global parameters' -- read as LS nibble then MS nibble per parameter, in the Param index order 0-9. Not verified on hardware; transpose/fine-tune values exceed 15 so both nibbles matter.
setup: Global menu: hold PROGRAM MODE until Global Parameter shows; PROGRAM knob picks, +/- changes.
MIDI Channel = the ch picked above.
Param Send = NRPN (front-panel moves show up here).
MIDI SysEx = On (needed for get + send).
Cable both ways: interface out → Mopho in, Mopho out → interface in.

programs.note: bank change = CC32 (0-2) then Program Change; sysexBank = the bank byte in program dump requests/writes
